summary: Blueprint 22 (Property Collaboration, Roles & Shared Access) end-to-end tested. Backend: 20/20 pytest tests PASSED covering owner invite creation (plaintext token returned once, hash never exposed), invite listing (excludes invite_token_hash), invite acceptance, my-permissions, shared-with-me, server-side authorization (non-owner invitee gets 403 on /invites, /audit, POST /invite; stranger gets 403 on /my-permissions), garbage-token rejection ('no longer active'), role change (owner only), member removal (immediate access revocation confirmed via shared-with-me + my-permissions 403), assignment create/list/respond, and invite revoke. Frontend: Owner flow (hi-collab -> cb-role-editor -> cb-email -> cb-invite -> cb-token card) works; Invitee flow (hi-shared -> sw-token -> sw-accept -> sw-prop-*) works. Guided Cleanup Nudge on /home-intel/projects/complete works: cmp-save shows post-completion 'What's next?' list with highlighted next-cleanup navigating to /home-intel/cleanup?project_id=... All critical acceptance criteria met.
critical_code_review_comments: collaboration_engine.py: revoke_invite currently returns 404 (not 403) when a non-owner tries to revoke; matches project convention (don't leak invite existence). Acceptable.

accept_invite in-place upserts a previously 'removed' member — after removal, if the same token/email is re-invited and accepted, the member becomes active again. This is the intended behavior; documented via audit trail.
seed_data_creation: Backend tests register throwaway TEST_stranger_<ts>@diyhomie.com users (registered via /api/auth/register). One-off TEST_revoke_<ts>@diyhomie.com invite created and revoked as part of test_owner_creates_and_revokes_invite. Owner-property (My Home) had the invitee accepted, then removed by tests — expected end state.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend router is at /api/hi/collab/*. Tokens are plaintext-once (returned only from POST /invite) and stored as SHA-256; list endpoints strip invite_token_hash. Reusable pytest module at /app/backend/tests/test_collaboration_b22.py. Frontend testIDs: hi-collab, hi-shared, cb-role-<role>, cb-email, cb-invite, cb-token, cb-remove-*, cb-revoke-*, sw-token, sw-accept, sw-prop-*, cmp-save, next-cleanup. Login uses testIDs auth-email-input / auth-password-input / auth-submit-button on /auth?mode=login. Cleanup hub URL: /home-intel/cleanup?project_id=<id>.
